alliance-content-intern.period: As soon as possible; end date not stated
alliance-content-intern.workMode: On site · Verdun and filming locations in Montreal
alliance-content-intern.applyInstructions: Use the role title as the email subject. No résumé is required; attach an approximately one-minute introduction video and a LinkedIn link, if available.
responsibilities: Film business and entrepreneurship videos; help with the content calendar and editing coordination.
Track views, retention and engagement, and suggest improvements.
requirements: Interest in digital content, sports and entrepreneurship; a related academic background is an asset.
Availability during office hours; availability outside those hours is an asset.
unknowns: Deadline, end date, academic agreement and international-applicant eligibility were not published.
alliance-content-intern.evidence: Listed in the official recruitment index, with an accessible full PDF and no published deadline. Confirm availability before applying.

roses-physio-intern.period: Weekday training, 08:00–14:00; start and end dates not published
roses-physio-intern.applyInstructions: Apply to the official email, stating your physiotherapy or athletic therapy studies, available dates and relevant training. The source does not require a fixed email subject.
responsibilities: Support training and matches, prepare equipment and assist with athletic taping under professional supervision.
Assist with prevention, recovery and athlete tracking records.
requirements: Enrolled in physiotherapy or athletic therapy, with athletic taping training.
First Responder certification and sports-team or event experience are assets.
unknowns: No deadline given; confirm the academic agreement, insurance and international-student eligibility.
roses-physio-intern.evidence: Listed on the official careers page; the two-page PDF was checked. This is a specialised health internship, not a role open to every field of study.

coverage.name: Junior leagues
coverage.description: Twelve Quebec and two New Brunswick QMJHL teams, plus the Ottawa 67’s. Included as leads for operations internships, not as adult professional teams.

coverage.name: Not yet reviewed team by team
coverage.description: LS PRO / Ligue1 Québec, other provincial semi-pro leagues, campus, community and amateur clubs, esports and organisations in dispersed francophone communities. Official league links are provided without claiming full coverage.

cautions: The research snapshot is dated September 13, 2026. It is not a live recruitment feed, and an accessible page does not confirm vacancies.
Not all clubs are hiring interns. The absence of a public posting does not mean a club never accepts interns.
Specific internships, academic-credit programs, regular jobs, volunteering, unsolicited contacts and expired notices are distinguished.
Undisclosed pay does not mean unpaid. An unpaid role does not automatically waive permit, insurance or academic-agreement requirements.
Chinese aliases are search aids. Use official French or English names in applications.
A group and multilingual versions of the same role are counted once. Group roles are not all assigned to one team.
Social links are supported by direct official-site links or official company pages. Unverified accounts are not guessed.
